int_name: BULK MAIL CENTER DWY & BYBERRY RD

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized intersection that is entirely devoid of pedestrian infrastructure, lacking sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. This environment is highly car-centric, forcing pedestrians to walk on unpaved shoulders or within the roadway itself.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Walkway
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to walk on the grass shoulder or in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the frame

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The signalized intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible at the intersection to indicate safe crossing times.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility continental or ladder patterns at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a multi-lane roadway with a complete absence of sidewalks, crosswalks, or pedestrian signals. Pedestrians are forced to use unpaved shoulders or the roadway, creating significant safety risks in a high-speed traffic environment.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossings forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible roadside and intersection area.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and lack of traffic calming suggest high vehicle speeds, increasing collision risk and severity.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the left side of the image limits sightlines between drivers and anyone attempting to cross or walk along the road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide a dedicated, safe space for pedestrians separated from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Signalized Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals with countdown timers at the intersection.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Reduce lane widths or the number of lanes to lower vehicle speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossing infrastructure at a signalized intersection. Pedestrians are forced to walk on unpaved grass shoulders, and there is no protected space or signalization for crossing the multi-lane roadway.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking any formal sidewalks, crossings, or lighting. A worn dirt path indicates pedestrian activity despite the absence of infrastructure, forcing people to walk on unpaved surfaces immediately adjacent to a high-speed roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk on a dirt path or the road shoulder due to the absence of a paved walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground along the road edge

hazards.name: No street lighting
hazards.description: The absence of luminaires creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians during low-light or nighttime conditions.

hazards.name: Degraded road shoulder
hazards.description: The edge of the asphalt is crumbling, creating uneven surfaces for anyone walking near the roadway.
